sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully preserves the authoritative ship ownership, calculation-case relationship and direction constraint, quantity datatypes and units, positive-shear envelope alternatives, and the FI = Cf × FIB calculation with MN-to-kN conversion and tolerance-based comparison. The violation query correctly rejects invalid envelope cases as well as formula mismatches, and deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: longitudinalDistributionFactor has authoritative requiredOwner ship, but the candidate places it on calculationCase and all formula/branch queries read it there. Keep the factor on the ship and reference that ship-owned value from the calculation-case checks without duplicating or relocating the property. Also encode shearForceDirection using a property shape with sh:hasValue nltl:positiveShearForce on the calculation case, rather than placing sh:hasValue on the nested node shape. Preserve the direct-calculation formula and bounded positive-shear alternatives after correcting these owner and value constraints.

Remove the second duplicate sh:property for nltl:designVerticalIceForceAtBow that imposes sh:nodeKind sh:IRI. The canonical range only requires a qudt:QuantityValue and does not authorize an IRI-only restriction, which can incorrectly reject a valid blank-node quantity. Retain the prior valid corrections: longitudinalDistributionFactor must remain ship-owned and be referenced from the calculation-case formula, and shearForceDirection must use sh:hasValue nltl:positiveShearForce on the calculation-case property shape. Preserve the direct-calculation branch envelope and FI = Cf × FIB check with the declared unit conversion and tolerance.

Preserve the prior owner and SHACL value-shape corrections: keep longitudinalDistributionFactor on the ship, reference that ship-owned value from the calculation-case checks, and constrain shearForceDirection with sh:hasValue nltl:positiveShearForce on the calculation-case property shape. Repair the SPARQL violation logic: it currently checks FI only when a valid Cf branch exists, so a case with an incorrect Cf or a position outside both specified intervals can pass because the query returns no row. For every supplied positive-shear calculation case, select a violation when the Cf/position envelope is not one of the two permitted alternatives, or when FI differs from Cf*FIB after the declared MN-to-kN conversion beyond the tolerance scaled from the expected result. Preserve explicit same-case pairing, the permitted gap between 0.6 and 0.9 LUI, and the existing direct-calculation structure.

Candidate faithfully preserves the authoritative ship ownership, calculation-case relationship and direction constraint, quantity datatypes and units, positive-shear envelope alternatives, and the FI = Cf × FIB calculation with MN-to-kN conversion and tolerance-based comparison. The violation query correctly rejects invalid envelope cases as well as formula mismatches, and deterministic validation is valid.
